label: Possible founded coming-to-be from founded populated pasts and possible earlier grounds
meaning: New non-transcription conditional support option for premise A3 prime of the modal spine, pricing horn H1 of the initial-state view. Take the accessible history in which every contingent concrete thing has an existing concrete ground present before it. Suppose a contingent concrete thing x present at t was never absent earlier. The populated moment t has a founded past, so some moment m at or below t has no earlier moment (ContingentComingToBe.minimalBelow); x is present at m; its ground must be present strictly before m, which is impossible. So every contingent concrete thing of that history comes to be, and the populated moment t has a founded past: founded coming-to-be is possible. Both premises are OPEN. Controls 4 and 5 show the temporal priority of grounds is needed: with simultaneous grounding a contingent thing can be grounded and never generated, with a necessary ground (4) or, without any necessary concrete individual, only with non-well-founded grounding (5), the horn BruteFoundationBoundary.bruteRootOrNonWellFounded already forces. Control 3 shows founded populated pasts are needed. No premise is established.
